productConcept.name: Celadon Paper Co.
productConcept.description: A letterpress and archival paper studio producing handmade cotton rag papers from an Auckland studio — papers pressed on a 1963 Vandercook proof press, each sheet formed by hand on traditional moulds.
productConcept.rationale: The light #f2f2f2 palette is the colour of paper itself — warm, not clinically white. Cormorant Garamond maps to the letterpress tradition (fine serifs, classical proportions). The languid motion (0.9s primary) reflects the actual pace of papermaking: drying takes 24 hours; rushing is not an option. The 50/50 editorial hero split is the right format for showing a physical studio product against a typographic argument for its existence.
